blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Jean Claude Saclag knows exactly what he needs to work on after settling for silver in the Asian Games 2026 mixed martial arts competition in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. The Filipino fighter identified his ground game as the biggest area for improvement after losing to Tajikistan’s Otabek Rajabov in the men’s traditional -65kg final on Tuesday. “Sayang talaga. Gusto ko talagang makakuha ng gold. Nag-expect ako na kaya kong mag-gold. Malungkot ako, hindi lang dahil natalo ako, kundi dahil sa performance ko,” Saclag said. “Hindi naman ako nahirapan sa transition […]...
